action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    inputs = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    for arr in inputs:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError("Log probability matrices must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All log probability values must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("All log probability values must be nonpositive")
    # Check shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Threshold must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = shape

    # Compute normalized weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)  # offsets 0..K-1
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()  # normalized, shape (K,)

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    # loss = - sum_t w_t * logp_t
    loss_plus = - (logp_with_result @ norm_weights)
    loss_call_only = - (logp_call_only @ norm_weights)
    loss_no_call = - (logp_no_call @ norm_weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margins and filtering (T04)
    margins = loss_minus - loss_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
